messages:
alex_w: Customer (FintechX) ping — they want a 6mo waiver of the on‑prem platform fee for a migration POC and a heavily discounted support tier during the POC. They say if POC succeeds they'll convert to Dedicated with a 12mo commit. Budget is tight. Can we do credits or temporary SKU mapping?

miriam_s: quick Q — how big is the POC (GPU/node estimate)? any KMS/HSM needs?

sam_e: POC estimate = 4 p4d-equivalent nodes, ~10k GPU hrs total across 6 months. They require customer-managed KMS + audit logs.

josh_s: ok. two levers here: one-time migration credit (applied to platform fee SKU) OR time-bound waiver tied to a signed PO/commit. my proposal below:

```
Migration credit (one-time): $40k credit applied to platform-fee SKU on invoice.
Conditional waiver: 6mo platform-fee waived IF signed LOI for Dedicated >= $150k ARR within 90 days of POC close.
Support: Standard included. Priority support: trial 30 days free during POC, then billed at 15% of committed ARR unless extended by deal desk.
```

josh_s: also recommend mapping support SKU to existing tiering so we don't create a bunch of one-off SKUs.

elaine_dd: Heads-up: deal desk can approve credits but needs clear commercial triggers + legal language. One-off credit up to $50k is approvable on commercial terms. Anything above that needs revenue leadership sign-off. For conditional waivers we need an escrow clause: credit clawback if customer cancels before commit window.

alex_w: understood. Customer is okay with LOI style commitment, they just want platform costs low during proof-of-value. Can we make the credit apply only to platform fee (not infra) and keep support trial separate?

elaine_dd: yes, can be platform-fee-only. Required conditions:
- Signed LOI with target ARR range (not just verbal)
- PO/first invoice paid for Dedicated within 90 days after POC close OR staged commit milestones (we accept staged).
- Standard T&Cs plus a clawback equal to credited amount if commit not met within 180 days.

tori_legal: add requirement: customer to accept limited export control clause and SOC2/PII adjacency language. If they want HSM/KMS integrations, include an SOW appendix clarifying who manages keys and access.

pricing_bot: automated rule: commits >= $200k/year -> platform-fee discount path (10%) available without exec sign-off. Credits and waivers still require manual deal-desk review.

alex_w: action items for me: 1) get LOI language from FintechX; 2) confirm they accept clawback; 3) capture expected node-hours in a short spreadsheet for pricing. I'll attach that to the deal desk request.

miriam_s: I'll draft the technical appendix for KMS/HSM + logging and a short test plan for the POC so they can sign off faster.

elaine_dd: once you have LOI + test plan + expected spend please fill the deal-desk form: https://redwood.internal/dealdesk (choose 'migration credit'). I'll prefill the review with this thread.

alex_w: will do. one more ask — can we offer a temporary mapping of platform fee to an 'evaluation SKU' so FintechX sees a line item = $0 for 6 months on their invoice (instead of a credit)? any accounting/reg implications?

elaine_dd: Accounting prefers credits over $0 SKUs for audit trail. We can issue a credit memo for the platform-fee SKU with clear description: 'Migration credit applied per LOI'. That passes audit and keeps invoices clean.

alex_w: perfect. i'll get LOI today and ping you. thanks team :thumbsup:

josh_s: once LOI in, i can prepare an estimated billing schedule so customer sees the commit breakpoints and the clawback triggers.

sam_e: i can stand up the POC infra and the key management appendix — will need network/IP allowlist and support contact.

elaine_dd: noted. i'll queue deal-desk review on receipt. if credit <= $50k we can likely turn in 48–72h. above that expect revenue handoff.

alex_w: got it. closing loop — i'll post LOI + spreadsheet here when ready.
